hypotheses.S1_forward_compatibility_is_local: L2H5 remains in the best decile when transplanted into L3H8 at every scale on both halves.
hypotheses.S2_forward_percentile_is_scale_stable: The forward partner percentile range is at most 0.15 across 0.05, 0.2, 0.5, and 1.0 on each half.
hypotheses.S3_reverse_direction_never_enters_top_de: L3H8 transplanted into L2H5 is outside the best decile at every tested scale on both halves.
hypotheses.S4_directional_gap_persists_locally: Reverse-minus-forward percentile is at least 0.30 at every scale and half.
hypotheses.S5_small_scale_effect_is_approximately_q: Between scales 0.05 and 0.2, partner KL divided by scale squared changes by at most a factor of two in both directions and halves.
